posts.title: 5 day water fasting reflection
posts.description: so i went for a five day water fast in bali. and the water fasting itself wasnt as challenging as i thought it would be. yes sometimes my stomach growls and im fantasizing about all the food i could be eating instead of beng here. as long as i don't pay too much attention to it, the hunger goes away. what was driving me crazy was all the other things that were part of the package: colonic and salt
